audit.conclusion: No remaining lifecycle defect found in the isolated scan or constant-count candidate. The derived count covers every production tail-state mutation and keeps abort separate from physical drained proof.
audit.count_invariant: unprovableWriteCount equals the number of current map entries with pending && (!unambiguous || generation != drainGeneration). Four stores compare old/new predicate; pending cancellation decrements pendingWrites, increments generation, then sets count=pendingWrites before deleting the canceled entry.
audit.recommendation: The counter removes measured growth in repeated rejected-drain admission (77.65 to 4025 ns for 1 to 1024 entries becomes roughly 50 ns) at the cost of ordinary callback maintenance (72.44 to 110.8 ns median for original write/confirmation/ACK). Retain the constant-cost counter with its lifecycle roots and both benchmark groups.
